description.value:
Effect The peach growing from a wildtwig’s horn is magical, tasting like the favorite fruit of the one who consumes it, providing them some temporary rejuvenation. A single fruit lasts for 8 hours after picked. When consumed as an Interact action, the peach provides temporary Hit Points equal to the creature’s level for 1 hour. Eating a second fruit within an hour provides no benefits, instead making the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} for 10 minutes. It takes 10 minutes for the wildtwig to grown another, and during this time, they must remain calm and focused on producing the fruit; they are unable to perform any other actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-specific-familiars.sf2e-specific-familiars-equipments.Item.8Y2TA4svwTyc7EPi]{Fruity Ambrosia}
